title: Summer Jazz in the Garden
description: Experience a magical evening under the open sky where Stockholm's city pulse meets the tranquility of nature. We offer a unique concert experience featuring award-winning jazz musicians blending classic standards with fresh original compositions. Organic drinks and light snacks will be available for purchase at our cozy garden bar throughout the evening. This is the perfect activity for both hardcore jazz enthusiasts and those just looking for a soulful summer night out.

title: Morning Yoga by the River
description: Start your Saturday the best way possible with a flowing yoga session right by the water's edge in Uppsala. We focus on waking up the body through gentle movements and conscious breathing in a harmonious outdoor environment. After the session, we gather for a shared breakfast bag filled with local ingredients and freshly brewed coffee. The class is led by experienced instructors and is adapted so that both beginners and regular practitioners get the most out of their morning.

title: Gothenburg Padel Open
description: It is finally time for the city's largest amateur padel tournament where joy and community take center stage. The tournament is played in a group stage format, which guarantees that all teams get to play at least three matches against equal opposition. Between matches, we provide sports drinks, fruit, and the chance to win great prizes from our local sponsors. Sign up with a partner for a day filled with fast-paced rallies and new acquaintances.

title: Street Art Walk Malmö
description: Join us for a guided walking tour where we explore the hidden galleries that Malmö's building walls provide. We visit both internationally recognized murals and lesser-known graffiti spots in the trendy neighborhoods around Möllevången. During the tour, our expert explains the techniques behind the art and the political history that shaped the city's urban expression. It is a perfect chance to see the city from a new perspective and take amazing photos.

title: Salsa Night Fever
description: Let the rhythms take over and experience a night filled with passion and dance in one of Stockholm's most beautiful dance halls. The evening begins with an intensive trial lesson where our professional instructors teach the most basic steps of Salsa and Bachata. After the lesson, we open the floor for social dancing where all levels are welcome to practice and mingle. No partner is required for registration – we rotate during the session so everyone gets to dance.

title: Networking & Afterwork
description: This is the meeting point for anyone looking to expand their professional network in Uppsala in a relaxed and unpretentious environment. We invite entrepreneurs, freelancers, and creators to an evening of inspiring short talks and structured mingling. Light drinks and finger foods are served while you discuss future ideas with like-minded individuals in a creative setting. Don't forget your business cards, but come as you are and prepare for meaningful conversations.

title: Indie Rock Night
description: Experience tomorrow's stars today as three of Gothenburg's most promising indie bands take the stage for a full night of music. We promise high energy, distorted guitars, and that unique club feeling that only live music can create. Between acts, our DJs will play the latest hits from the international indie scene to keep the atmosphere at its peak. Arrive early to secure your spot at the front of the stage and support the local music scene.

title: Slottsskogen Nature Hike
description: Join a guided nature walk through one of Gothenburg's most beloved city parks. We will hike along lesser-known paths, observe the local wildlife, and learn about the park's fascinating history and flora. The hike ends at one of the prepared barbecue areas where we provide sausages (including vegan options) and fika over an open fire. It is an excellent opportunity to breathe fresh air and meet new friends in a relaxed environment.

title: Modern Dance Workshop
description: Deepen your understanding of the body as an instrument in this intensive full-day workshop in modern and contemporary dance. We work with floor technique, center of gravity, and improvisation to find new ways of expressing emotions through movement. The workshop is led by a guest teacher from the Royal Ballet and is aimed at those who have some previous dance experience. Prepare for a physically challenging but mentally stimulating day with other passionate dancers.

title: Board Game Night Deluxe
description: Leave your screens at home and dive into a world of analog adventure during our big board game night in Stockholm. We have stocked up on over 50 different titles, ranging from quick party games to heavy strategy games that require hours of focus. Our game hosts are on site all evening to explain rules and help you find a group to play with. We offer unlimited snacks, coffee, and an atmosphere where your competitive spirit can thrive among friends.

title: Vernissage: Digital Future
description: Welcome to an exclusive preview of autumn's most talked-about exhibition where the boundaries between human creativity and AI are blurred. The gallery is filled with interactive installations, generative art, and digital sculptures created by leading Nordic artists. During the evening, we serve refreshments and give you the chance to talk directly with the creators behind the technical works. A thought-provoking evening for everyone interested in how technology will change our view of aesthetics.

title: Tennis Clinic: Serve & Volley
description: Take your tennis game to the next level with a technique-oriented clinic focusing entirely on offensive play and net play. We work in small groups of a maximum of four players per court to ensure everyone receives personal feedback and plenty of ball contact. Our coaches use video analysis to show how you can improve your serve motion and get more power in your volleys. Best suited for those who already play regularly and want to polish the technical details.

title: Zumba Party Outdoor
description: Get ready for the summer's sweatiest and happiest party under the open sky at Ribersborg beach. We combine training with a party feeling to the latest Latin American hits and heavy beats. The instructors lead the class with an energy that is contagious, and the steps are easy to follow regardless of previous experience. Bring a water bottle, sunscreen, and your biggest smile for an hour of pure joy of movement by the sea.

title: Meditation Retreat (Half Day)
description: Give yourself a break from the noise of everyday life and check in for a morning entirely dedicated to inner peace and recovery. Through guided meditations, simple breathing exercises, and periods of total silence, we learn to land in the present moment. We are located in a nature-oriented venue where stillness takes center stage, and we end the session with a strengthening herbal tea ceremony. No previous experience is required, just a willingness to sit down and listen inward for a while.

title: Hip Hop Showcase
description: Join us for an evening where urban culture takes the stage with a mix of heavy beats and sharp rhymes. We present a hand-picked lineup of both established acts and the hottest newcomers on the Swedish hip-hop scene. In addition to the music, there will be breakdance performances and live graffiti creating a complete visual experience. This is more than just a concert; it's a tribute to the movement and community within Swedish hip-hop.

title: Vegan Gourmet Cooking Class
description: Learn to create impressive dishes that are completely plant-based but do not compromise on taste or texture. Under the guidance of a professional chef, we go through advanced techniques to transform simple ingredients into gastronomic masterpieces. We cook a three-course menu together and then sit down to enjoy the result with matching non-alcoholic drinks. You will take all the recipes home so you can impress friends and family at your next dinner.

title: Photo Exhibit: City Life
description: This poignant exhibition showcases Malmö's most honest and raw sides through the lenses of ten local street photographers. The images capture small moments of beauty in everyday life – from the morning commute on a bicycle to late nights at local cafes. Each photograph tells its own story of identity, belonging, and the rapid change the city is undergoing right now. The exhibition is free and is perfect for an inspiring weekend walk in the name of art.

title: CrossFit Challenge
description: Challenge yourself and your friends in a team competition that tests strength, stamina, and cooperation. The competition consists of three different 'WODs' designed so that everyone can participate, whether they are elite athletes or happy exercisers. There will be officials on site to ensure all lifts are performed safely and with good technique. The audience is welcome to cheer the teams on to the sound of loud music and encouraging commentary from our speaker.

title: Swing Dance Workshop
description: Step back to the happy days of the 1930s and learn the basics of Lindy Hop, the most energetic of all swing dances. During this afternoon, we go through basic steps, turns, and the characteristic communication between leader and follower. No previous knowledge is required and we change partners often, making it a fantastic way to get to know new people. We promise lots of laughter, great music, and a guaranteed sweaty experience on the dance floor.

title: Pub Quiz: Music & Film
description: Think you know everything about Oscar winners and 80s hits? Gather a team of 2-4 people and come down to our cozy cellar pub in Uppsala for a prestigious battle for the title of the city's biggest pop culture nerds. The quiz includes everything from image questions and audio clips to tricky follow-up questions that require both cooperation and fast reflexes. Great prizes are at stake, but the biggest win is, as always, the honor and a really nice evening in good company.
